content: JWT-scoped RLS from Python: two viable paths. (1) supabase-py 2.31.0 / AsyncPostgrestClient — pass Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt> per request so PostgREST runs as authenticated with auth.uid() populated; simple, but cannot issue SET LOCAL, so pgvector hnsw.iterative_scan and multi-statement hybrid search must be wrapped in SQL functions and called via .rpc(). (2) asyncpg 0.31.0 direct pool — per request open a transaction and SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', <json>, true), set_config('role','authenticated',true); this gives full SET LOCAL control including hnsw.iterative_scan=strict_order and lets the 5-channel search run as parallel queries. asyncpg has no prepared-statement compatibility with Supabase transaction-mode pooler unless statement_cache_size=0.
